Slide Ball Maze

Roll fast. Think bright.

Slide wooden maze tiles, connect the path, and guide a glowing ball into the goal. Each offline level is compact, tactile, and tuned for quick puzzle sessions with a cheerful wooden style.

Privacy Policy

Game Features

Wooden Puzzle FeelBright carved boards, polished buttons, and clean tile movement make every round satisfying.
Offline PlayNo account, no network, and no data collection. Open the game and play anywhere.
Progress & StarsClear levels, earn star ratings, unlock progress, and improve your move count.
Ball SkinsChoose glowing balls or a wooden ball skin to match your puzzle mood.
